note: Wooded urban-edge park between Cedar Falls and Waterloo with four lakes and the Cedar River; the campground sits in a clearing in the woods near the river, with no water at the sites. Cedar Valley Trails start from the campground. No daily park-entry fee in Iowa. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50 amp, showers, dump, RA booking, $12/16 non-electric and $20/24 electric on RA's 2026-27 table (stored, not rewritten), season. Count 60->59 (host site out), max 60->65, FCFS never (100% reservable). Pin ~480 m off. Not waterfront stands.
